\"/assets/blog/hello-world/cover.jpg\"\ndate: \"2025-10-28\"\nauthor:\n  name: 小羽\n  picture: \"/assets/blog/authors/jj.jpeg\"\nogImage:\n  url: \"/assets/blog/dynamic-routing/cover.jpg\"\n---\n\n# React服务端渲染与Next.js深度解析（二）：数据获取与路由系统\n\n## 前言\n\n在上一篇文章中，我们了解了React服务端渲染的基础知识和Next.js的入门方法。本文将继续深入探讨Next.js的数据获取方法、路由系统和API路由，帮助你掌握Next.js的核心功能，构建全栈React应用。\n\n## Next.js数据获取方法\n\n### 客户端数据获取\n\n使用SWR或React Query在客户端获取数据：\n\n```tsx\n// pages/profile.tsx\nimport useSWR from 'swr'\n\n// fetcher函数\nconst fetcher = (url: string) => fetch(url).then(res => res.json())\n\nfunction Profile() {\n  // 使用SWR获取数据\n  const { data, error, isLoading } = useSWR('/api/user', fetcher)\n  \n  if (error) return <div>Failed to load</div>\n  if (isLoading) return <div>Loading...</div>\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>{data.name}</h1>\n      <p>Email: {data.email}</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nexport default Profile\n\n// 使用React Query\nimport { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'\n\nfunction ProfileWithReactQuery() {\n  const { data, error, isLoading } = useQuery({\n    queryKey: ['user'],\n    queryFn: () => fetch('/api/user').then(res => res.json())\n  })\n  \n  if (error) return <div>Failed to load</div>\n  if (isLoading) return <div>Loading...</div>\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>{data.name}</h1>\n      <p>Email: {data.email}</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n## Next.js路由系统\n\n### 基本路由\n\n```tsx\n// pages/index.tsx - 首页 (/)\nexport default function HomePage() {\n  return <h1>Home Page</h1>\n}\n\n// pages/about.tsx - 关于页面 (/about)\nexport default function AboutPage() {\n  return <h1>About Page</h1>\n}\n\n// pages/blog/index.tsx - 博客列表页 (/blog)\nexport default function BlogListPage() {\n  return <h1>Blog List</h1>\n}\n\n// pages/blog/[slug].tsx - 动态博客页面 (/blog/my-first-post)\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/router'\n\nexport default function BlogPostPage() {\n  const router = useRouter()\n  const { slug } = router.query\n  \n  return <h1>Blog Post: {slug}</h1>\n}\n```\n\n### 动态路由与捕获所有路由\n\n```tsx\n// pages/docs/[...slug].tsx - 捕获所有路由 (/docs/getting-started/installation)\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/router'\n\nexport default function DocPage() {\n  const router = useRouter()\n  const { slug } = router.query // slug = ['getting-started', 'installation']\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>Documentation</h1>\n      <p>Path: {slug?.join('/')}</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// pages/shop/[category]/[item].tsx - 多级动态路由\nexport default function ShopItemPage() {\n  const router = useRouter()\n  const { category, item } = router.query\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>{item}</h1>\n      <p>Category: {category}</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n### 路由导航\n\n```tsx\n// 使用Link组件进行客户端导航\nimport Link from 'next/link'\n\nfunction Navigation() {\n  return (\n    <nav>\n      <Link href=\"/\">\n        <a>Home</a>\n      </Link>\n      <Link href=\"/about\">\n        <a>About</a>\n      </Link>\n      <Link href=\"/blog/my-first-post\">\n        <a>Blog Post</a>\n      </Link>\n      \n      {/* 动态路由 */}\n      <Link href={`/docs/${docPath}`}>\n        <a>Documentation</a>\n      </Link>\n    </nav>\n  )\n}\n\n// 使用useRouter进行程序化导航\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/router'\n\nfunction LoginForm() {\n  const router = useRouter()\n  \n  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {\n    event.preventDefault()\n    \n    // 登录逻辑...\n    \n    // 登录成功后重定向\n    router.push('/dashboard')\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>\n      {/* 表单字段 */}\n      <button type=\"submit\">Login</button>\n    </form>\n  )\n}\n\n// 路由参数\nfunction PostPage() {\n  const router = useRouter()\n  const { id } = router.query\n  \n  return <div>Post ID: {id}</div>\n}\n```\n\n## Next.js API路由\n\n### 基本API路由\n\n```ts\n// pages/api/hello.ts - API路由 (/api/hello)\nimport type { NextApiRequest, NextApiResponse } from 'next'\n\ntype ResponseData = {\n  message: string\n  timestamp: string\n}\n\nexport default function handler(\n  req: NextApiRequest,\n  res: NextApiResponse<ResponseData>\n) {\n  // 处理不同的HTTP方法\n  switch (req.method) {\n    case 'GET':\n      // GET请求处理\n      res.status(200).json({\n        message: 'Hello from Next.js API!',\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\n      })\n      break\n      \n    case 'POST':\n      // POST请求处理\n      const { name } = req.body\n      \n      if (!name) {\n        return res.status(400).json({ \n          message: 'Name is required',\n          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\n        })\n      }\n      \n      res.status(201).json({\n        message: `Hello, ${name}!`,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\n      })\n      break\n      \n    default:\n      // 不支持的方法\n      res.setHeader('Allow', ['GET', 'POST'])\n      res.status(405).json({\n        message: `Method ${req.method} Not Allowed`,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\n      })\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 动态API路由\n\n```ts\n// pages/api/users/[id].ts - 动态API路由 (/api/users/123)\nimport type { NextApiRequest, NextApiResponse } from 'next'\n\nexport default async function handler(\n  req: NextApiRequest,\n  res: NextApiResponse\n) {\n  const { id } = req.query\n  \n  // 根据HTTP方法处理请求\n  switch (req.method) {\n    case 'GET':\n      // 获取用户信息\n      try {\n        const user = await getUserById(id as string)\n        \n        if (!user) {\n          return res.status(404).json({ message: 'User not found' })\n        }\n        \n        res.status(200).json(user)\n      } catch (error) {\n        res.status(500).json({ message: 'Internal server error' })\n      }\n      break\n      \n    case 'PUT':\n      // 更新用户信息\n      try {\n        const updatedUser = await updateUser(id as string, req.body)\n        res.status(200).json(updatedUser)\n      } catch (error) {\n        res.status(500).json({ message: 'Internal server error' })\n      }\n      break\n      \n    case 'DELETE':\n      // 删除用户\n      try {\n        await deleteUser(id as string)\n        res.status(204).end()\n      } catch (error) {\n        res.status(500).json({ message: 'Internal server error' })\n      }\n      break\n      \n    default:\n      res.setHeader('Allow', ['GET', 'PUT', 'DELETE'])\n      res.status(405).json({ message: `Method ${req.method} Not Allowed` })\n  }\n}\n\n// 模拟数据库操作\nasync function getUserById(id: string) {\n  // 实际应用中，这里会查询数据库\n  return { id, name: 'John Doe', email: 'john@example.com' }\n}\n\nasync function updateUser(id: string, data: any) {\n  // 实际应用中，这里会更新数据库\n  return { id, ...data }\n}\n\nasync function deleteUser(id: string) {\n  // 实际应用中，这里会从数据库删除用户\n  return true\n}\n```\n\n### 中间件\n\n```ts\n// middleware.ts - 全局中间件\nimport { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'\n\nexport function middleware(request: NextRequest) {\n  // 获取请求路径\n  const path = request.nextUrl.pathname\n  \n  // 检查认证状态\n  const token = request.cookies.get('auth_token')?.value\n  \n  // 保护需要认证的路由\n  if (path.startsWith('/dashboard') && !token) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', request.url))\n  }\n  \n  // 添加自定义头\n  const response = NextResponse.next()\n  response.headers.set('x-custom-header', 'custom-value')\n  \n  return response\n}\n\n// 配置中间件匹配的路径\nexport const config = {\n  matcher: ['/dashboard/:path*', '/api/protected/:path*']\n}\n```\n\n## Next.js样式与优化\n\n### CSS模块\n\n```tsx\n// components/Button.module.css\n.button {\n  padding: 10px 20px;\n  border-radius: 5px;\n  font-weight: bold;\n  transition: background-color 0.2s;\n}\n\n.primary {\n  background-color: blue;\n  color: white;\n}\n\n.primary:hover {\n  background-color: darkblue;\n}\n\n.secondary {\n  background-color: gray;\n  color: white;\n}\n\n// components/Button.tsx\nimport styles from './Button.module.css'\n\ntype ButtonProps = {\n  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary'\n  children: React.ReactNode\n  onClick?: () => void\n}\n\nexport default function Button({ variant = 'primary', children, onClick }: ButtonProps) {\n  return (\n    <button \n      className={`${styles.button} ${styles[variant]}`}\n      onClick={onClick}\n    >\n      {children}\n    </button>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n### 全局样式\n\n```css\n/* styles/globals.css */\n/* 全局样式 */\nhtml,\nbody {\n  padding: 0;\n  margin: 0;\n  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Oxygen,\n    Ubuntu, Cantarell, Fira Sans, Droid Sans, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif;\n}\n\na {\n  color: inherit;\n  text-decoration: none;\n}\n\n/* 响应式设计 */\n@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {\n  html {\n    color-scheme: dark;\n  }\n  body {\n    color: white;\n    background: black;\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## 总结\n\n在本篇文章中，我们深入了解了Next.js的数据获取方法（包括客户端数据获取、SWR和React Query的使用）、路由系统（基本路由、动态路由和路由导航）以及API路由的创建和使用。这些功能是Next.js的核心特性，能够帮助开发者构建功能强大的全栈React应用。\n\n在下一篇文章中，我们将继续探讨Next.js的样式优化、图片优化、构建配置和实际应用案例，帮助你全面掌握Next.js的高级特性和最佳实践。\n\n"
